analysis:
Examined the added Autopilot download, ledger, settings, model-set and start-inventory sources and the telemetry-schema doc update. I found no qualifying regression in the supplied evidence.

Download path (AutopilotDownload.swift 85-116): it gates on the catalog entry, a reportable ID, catalogAllows, and a present r2Prefix and aggregateSHA256. It then applies the disk/cap budget and calls the existing ModelDownloader.prefetch. Errors map to a closed refusal vocabulary and detail stays in the local log, so nothing sensitive reaches the coordinator. Disk guard fails closed on an unknown free figure (lines 43-47) and saturates on overflow. Unknown: whether ModelDownloader still verifies the manifest and aggregate hash (T-012/T-027 mitigation); that code is not in this batch.

Observations for integration (not findings):
(1) The refusal doc (lines 10-13) says an unsupported engine family or an over-budget size yields model_not_supported, but prefetchToDisk only calls catalogAllows. allowsScannedBuild is not applied pre-download. Impact is bounded by the disk reserve and caps, so this is a functional gap, not a security one.
(2) AutopilotDownloadSettings defaults enabled=true for machines with saved consent, with no default storage cap and a 50 GiB reserve. The model set (AutopilotModelSet) also widens to all verified cached catalog builds without a new consent step. This changes consent semantics and disk-use exposure (T-016 class). The trigger is coordinator-initiated prefetch, and the coordinator is trusted. Check that the caller honors enabled, paused and consent.
(3) AutopilotStartInventory.inventory (lines 77-86) falls back to the local ledger hash when the catalog is unreachable. The ledger is operator-writable, so a local operator could register altered weights. That is already the operator-controlled T-012 surface, and coordinator-side weight-hash checks are the intended control, which I could not verify here. The ledger read (45263e2979883ac2 lines 84-85) loads the full file before the size check, which is minor. Ledger writes use a 0600 temp file plus atomic rename.
(4) isCandidate/inventory trust settings.allows(model.id) without a hash check, which matches prior behavior for the persisted selection.

The telemetry doc change adds only heartbeat/state diagnostics gated on consent and adds no event fields. Callers (ProviderLoop, prefetch handler, background verification) were not supplied.
